_README: Tanker fuel pumps — shipped as its OWN mod, not as part of the island.
Kept out of vehicles.json on purpose: that file is the ISLAND's, and
the island build must not ship these rows or the standalone mod and
Arini would fight over the same vehicle tables.
See _TANKER_SURVEY for how the twelve tankers were identified, and each
entry's own note for where its interaction point came from.
WATER IS A FUEL TYPE. EMTFuelType is Invalid/Gasoline/Diesel/Electric/
Water, so a pump slot set to Water dispenses water -- which is what lets a
tanker refill a fire engine. Read it with:
Do not infer enum members by grepping the mappings for strings: cooked
assets store enums as byte indices and a search for 'water' drowns in
Unreal's own water-body names while Electric never appears at all.
_TANKER_SURVEY: CargoSpaceType on the vehicle's cargo space component is what identifies a
tanker -- not the row name. Names are useless here: most trailers are bare
brand names (Bulko, Olbe, Oldum, Lomax) that say nothing about what they
haul, Shotan_7 sits beside Shobed and Shovan in a bed/van/tan family, and
Kuda_LiveFishTank_4x2 matches every tank filter while hauling fish -- it
Cooked assets store property names as mapping indices, so grepping the
bytes for 'CargoSpaceType' finds nothing; all 174 vehicle classes have to
vanilla already had a pump: Brutus_FireEngine, Brutus_Tanker,
plus Kira_Tanker, which has no CargoSpaceType but is a tanker in game.

modify._: Mobile fuel station. The Brutus fire engine already works this way; the only thing it had that the trailer lacked was the component. A 30ft tanker carries far more than the Brutus, which is the point of doing it here.

modifications._: Set to -500 by hand after testing in game. The earlier reasoning that -900ish was the rear face assumed the actor root sits at the kingpin; -500 landing right means the root is nearer the middle of the trailer than that.

What the TANK accepts. The pump's Slots decide what it gives out; this decides what a hydrant or station may put in. Without Water here a hydrant answers 'wrong fuel type' no matter how the pump is set.

modify._: Kira Tanker. FUEL ONLY, by decision -- water is deliberately not wired up here. It has no cargo space of its own: no CargoSpaceType, no components, and a 6-byte (empty) InheritableComponentHandler, so its tank comes wholesale from MTVehicleBaseBP_C. There is nothing on this asset to hang AllowedFuelTypes on, and editing the base class would reach every vehicle inheriting from it. The pump and the Tanker_FuelPump interaction still apply, so it dispenses and carries fuel exactly as before; it simply will not take water. Leave it that way.
